option_relations.rationale: Fibrolipoma does not match the histological findings of mature adipose and fibrous tissues in the context of the clinical presentation.
Hamartoma is a broad term that does not specifically match the clinical and histological description provided.
The description of fibrofatty residua of involuted infantile hemangioma matches the histological findings and clinical presentation.
Lipoma does not account for the fibrous tissue component described in the histological findings.
